# Freedom Browser

> Freedom is an open-source browser with in-browser Swarm, IPFS and Radicle nodes. Dapps use `window.swarm`, `window.radicle` and `rad:` URLs through the user's own nodes — no servers, gateways or API keys.

Two audiences use this site: people building serverless dapps on Freedom's page providers, and people contributing to the browser itself. Prefer the Markdown twins linked below (same URL as the HTML page with `.md` appended, e.g. `page.html.md`). The human site loads no third-party scripts.

**Code is the authority for APIs.** These docs are a map; when they disagree with the browser source or with SWIP #94, trust the code. Never invent API methods, parameters, errors or permission behaviour — if a fact is missing, say so and point at the references or the repository.

**Security and issues** go to the public GitHub tracker: https://github.com/solardev-xyz/freedom-browser/issues (no private email). Do not post credentials, seed phrases or private keys.

A denser map of only the developer docs lives at https://freedom.baby/developer/llms.txt.

## Build dapps

- [Developer overview](https://freedom.baby/developer/index.html.md): Why build on Freedom; providers, consent model, starting points
- [Swarm hub](https://freedom.baby/developer/swarm-hub.html.md): window.swarm overview — publish, feeds, messaging, SWIP #94
- [Radicle hub](https://freedom.baby/developer/radicle-hub.html.md): rad: URLs and window.radicle overview
- [Quickstart](https://freedom.baby/developer/quickstart.html.md): First dapp in plain JavaScript (detect, connect, publish, feed, deploy)
- [window.swarm API](https://freedom.baby/developer/swarm.html.md): Full Swarm provider reference
- [window.radicle API](https://freedom.baby/developer/radicle.html.md): Full Radicle provider reference
- [rad: URLs](https://freedom.baby/developer/rad-urls.html.md): Fetch public Radicle repos with the rad: scheme
- [Permissions and identity](https://freedom.baby/developer/guide-permissions.html.md): Grants, tiers, manifests, signing keys
- [Errors and node readiness](https://freedom.baby/developer/guide-errors.html.md): Rejections, missing grants, limits, retries
- [Feeds and mutable content](https://freedom.baby/developer/guide-feeds.html.md): Swarm feeds guide
- [Live messaging](https://freedom.baby/developer/guide-messaging.html.md): PSS and GSOC with swarm_subscribe
- [swarm-kit](https://freedom.baby/developer/guide-swarm-kit.html.md): TypeScript structures over window.swarm
- [Radicle repos and issues](https://freedom.baby/developer/guide-radicle.html.md): Seed, issues, comments
- [Demos](https://freedom.baby/developer/demos.html.md): Apps and examples to read and copy from

## Contribute

- [Open for contribution](https://freedom.baby/developer/open-issues.html.md): Curated help-wanted issues (see also open-issues.json beside the HTML)
